controls.name: calculated_altermagnetic_splitting
controls.definition: Calculated energy splitting between the two magnon bands used for comparison with the fitted Gaussian peak widths.

readouts.name: resolution_broadened_peak_width
readouts.definition: Calculated magnon splitting after adding the minimum peak-width offset for comparison with fitted Gaussian peak widths.

applicability.statement: This additive relation is the source's plotting comparison for half-integer-L peak broadening; the 28 microeV term represents the minimum width attributed to instrumental resolution.
The nonzero splitting value is approximate and corresponds to the source's model with exchange anisotropy |J7a-J7b|=5 microeV; zero denotes the explicitly shown zero-splitting comparison.
